comment: ANCHOR: PIPELINE_STAGE_LABELS_20261104 — FQ-032: on a phone the work-pipeline stage strip NAMES the current stage in words (data-current cell keeps its label, bars are tall enough to carry it) instead of showing a stack of unlabeled coloured bars; the other cells stay compact and every cell keeps its accessible label.
